# Consider the code chunk below that generates a bootstrap distribution for a population mean.  You will have to modify it to accomplish the tasks set forth in your exam.
```{r}
# reserve space for your bootstrap statistics
BootStats <- rep(NA, 2000)           # modify this line

# generate bootstrap samples and save statistics
for(i in 1:2000){                    # modify this line
  TempSample <- sample_n(BikeCommute,         # modify this line
                       size = 56,              # modify this line
                       replace = T )
  BootStats[i] <- mean(~Minutes, data = TempSample) 
}

sd(BootStats)

```

# Again, here's another code chunk in case you want to use it.
```{r}
# this is code calculate the Pth percentile from a vector named MyVector

quantile(BootStats, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))
quantile(BootStats, 0.05)
```
